title: Avoiding the Reverse Fall Mistake in Drainage Installation
description: One of the most frequent errors in drainage installation is failing to maintain consistent gravity fall, resulting in flat spots or reverse slopes where wastewater can pool. In this lesson, we break down why a reverse fall traps solid waste and leads to recurring clogs. You will learn the importance of verifying your horizontal alignment before cementing joints, using proper support hangers to prevent pipe sagging over time, and checking your slope with an accurate level to ensure smooth, uninterrupted flow. Understanding how minor installation flaws compound into major service calls is essential for professional workmanship.

Avoiding the Reverse Fall Mistake in Drainage Installation
